name: Rep. Matsumoto High School Legislative Internship
org: Office of Hawaii State Representative Lauren Cheape Matsumoto
what_you_do: Help a state lawmaker's office during the legislative session. Some interns may continue through the end of the session after May.
who_can_apply: Juniors and seniors in good academic standing. The program page gives no age rule.
pay_detail: The program page says these are non-paid positions.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Send an application, a resume, a news-style writing sample and one recommendation letter. You can apply online through the link on the page, or mail or email the materials. Phone: 808-586-9490.
notes: This is one lawmaker's office. The page does not say if you must live in her district. The email link on the page may point to the wrong address, so use the phone number to confirm.
